milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because chopping oak trees yields oak_log items that end up in the player's inventory. The player starts with NO oak_log, so any oak_log present proves tree-chopping occurred. The iron axe is provided to facilitate this.

Uses inventory_has because crafting a coal_block (9 coal in 3x3 grid on crafting table) results in the item appearing in inventory. The player starts with 9 coal and 0 coal_blocks, so any coal_block in inventory proves successful crafting. The player must first craft a crafting table from chopped wood (no crafting table is pre-placed in the scene), making this genuinely dependent on the tree-chopping milestone.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'interact with brewingstand' requires the player to navigate to the brewing stand and face it to right-click. The brewing stand is at spawn-relative (-3, 0, 4). We check that the player is within 3 blocks and facing toward it (within 60 degrees), which is the physical prerequisite for right-click interaction. Since the evaluator cannot directly detect GUI opening, proximity + facing is the best available proxy for interaction intent after completing the prior sequential milestones.
